document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
“As you wish. I see darkness, and you alone. There is blood, blood. 
Now I see ice, as though the whole world has frozen. Now ... 
Oh! How horrible! No! No! I must stop!” 
She stares at you as though you are a monster and, gasping, 
ushers you out. Return to the market at 134.
(378)
